title: Incident-ready export
ownerOnlyNotice: The incident-ready export is the shop's own account of a departure, so only an owner can produce one. Everything it draws on — the roll call, the timeline, each diver's status — is on this manifest.
description: One document of what was recorded for this departure — boarding, the roll-call timeline, certification evidence, and waiver status — ready to print and hand to authorities or insurers.
factsOnly: This document reports recorded facts with their timestamps. It does not assess, certify, or imply any safety judgment.
rosterDescription: Every active booking on this departure’s manifest, with the recorded result at each checkpoint. A checkpoint with no recorded result reads “Awaiting roll call” — an absence is stated, never left blank. Buddy team is the grouping staff recorded in DiveDay for this departure, not for each dive; a team has two or more members and may include a crew member, who is marked as such. A blank is not a statement that anyone dived alone — many shops record no teams at all.
buddyPairedByUnknown: Recorder and time not on record
crewNone: No crew was assigned to this departure.
evidenceDescription: Cards as held on the shop’s records when this document was generated, with their review dates. Waiver status only — medical questionnaire answers are never part of this document.
waiverCompleteAttested: Recorded by staff from an in-person signature.
waiverCompleteImported: Imported acceptance from a prior system — not signed through this shop’s own release.
waiverNotSigned: No current signed waiver on record.
waiverPending: A waiver link was issued and has not been signed.
waiverMedicalReview: Medical review flagged as required — status only; the questionnaire’s answers are not part of this document.
timelineDescription: Every roll-call entry recorded for this departure, oldest first, corrections included — entries are append-only, so a correction adds a line and never rewrites one.
timelineEmpty: No roll-call entries have been recorded for this departure.
footerHashExplainer: Computed from this document’s recorded facts. Generating the export again from unchanged records reproduces the same code, so two copies can be checked against each other.
